data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Performance Metrics Calculation
features.description: Calculate key performance metrics from the ingested pipeline data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are accurately calculated based on predefined formulas.
Metrics include execution time, success rate, and resource utilization.
Calculated metrics are stored in a retrievable format.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a system to ingest data from recent pipeline runs for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully ingested from all relevant pipeline sources.
Ingestion process handles data in various formats.
System logs any ingestion errors for troubleshooting.

features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance based on analyzed data.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are generated based on performance metrics.
Recommendations include actionable steps for improvement.
Users receive notifications of new recommendations.

features.title: Data Visualization
features.description: Create visualizations to represent pipeline performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include graphs and charts for key metrics.
Users can filter visualizations by date range and pipeline.
Visualizations update dynamically with new data.
